judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a spec update (`specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`), and a new acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/usageAcrossToolRounds.acceptance.test.ts`), completely omitting the actual production implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still assigns `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` instead of accumulating usage across rounds, the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately (`npm test` does not pass). Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature to make total usage unambiguous, nor did it add the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
